snippet.title: Horses of Hoofprint Bay 🐴💕 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the free demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4335510/Horses_of_Hoofprint_Bay_Demo/
Wishlist the full game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3727090/Horses_of_Hoofprint_Bay/

Horses of Hoofprint Bay is a lovingly hand-drawn 2D point and click barn buildup game. Take care of your horses, train them to build up their strength and confidence, and compete for prize money! Breed adorable foals, hire and manage staff, and build the stable of your dreams! 

The game is made by thogli studios and financially supported by FFF Bayern and the budgetary funds of the Free State of
Bavaria
Learn more: https://thoglistudios.com/
Music & SFX by Michal Sinka: https://www.michalsinka.com/

Follow for Updates 👇 
📷 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thoglistudios/
🦋 Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/thoglistudios.com
✉️ Newsletter: https://thoglistudios.com/
